newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon raises Xerox.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon raises Xerox.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said analyst Jonathan Rosenzweig raised the rating on Xerox Corp to strong buy from buy.
-- said at current price of $45.75, "the stock's risk/reward posture is extremely attractive."
-- shares were unchanged at 45-3/4 on the New York Stock Exchange. Set 12-month price target of $56-$57.

-- despite third quarter earnings shortfall and subsequent drop in stock price, "we believe that a combination of accelerated revenue growth and expanding margins will result in a solid performance for the company over the long haul."
